mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing policy, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 5.25% for the first time in a month, it signals the end of an easing cycle, prompting investors to discount future equities more heavily and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive over the 60-day horizon despite the tightening signal, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 jobs for two consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 60% of labor-strengthening windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.5% for the first time in a month, it signals a labor market inflection point that prompts significant equity reallocation toward growth sectors, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative over the 60-day horizon despite the inflection signal, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 112.3227 for two consecutive months signals a robust supply-side expansion, which lowers input costs and boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 60% of supply-side expansion windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) exceeding 1,588.0 for three consecutive months indicates resilient consumer demand, which raises earnings growth forecasts and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative over the 60-day horizon despite the demand signal, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail sales (HOUST) fall below 1,500.0 for two consecutive months, it signals weakening demand, prompting equity reallocation toward defensive sectors and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1,500.0 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative over the 20-day horizon despite the demand weakness, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index (CPI) over 3 consecutive months indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise rates, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive over the 20-day horizon despite the inflation signal, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.
